verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim SOC 2 Type II completion and a HIPAA-compliant pipeline with BAA for Enterprise customers, plus BYOC/self-hosting and regional endpoints for data residency, directly addressing contract/medical-record processing needs. However, zero-retention handling specifically is not explicitly documented, HIPAA is gated behind 'Enterprise' tier, and there is no independent/third-party audit corroboration or hands-on confirmation of these compliance claims. Missing for 10: explicit zero-retention policy documentation, independent verification of SOC2/HIPAA claims, and clarity on whether zero-retention applies outside Enterprise tier.
